verdictA.finding: Repeated saved-Showcase extraction is not proven. The .111 native observation was resource-invalid and retry-refused; no healthy installed run, real recipe, approval, capture, or repeated-row comparison was performed in this lane.
verdictA.sourceAssessment: The proposed progress strings distinguish connection, preparation, and approval. Port abort gives the row a terminal cancellation after the Port exists. Existing prepared-operation checks reject an aborted signal before confirmation, after confirmation, and before capture following a late preparation result. These are source observations, not live behavior proof.

findings.title: Cancellation test does not prove the real UI-to-dispatch path
findings.evidence: preapproval-stall.test.tsx.pending mocks runSavedPattern and manufactures its progress/cancellation race; its separate Port test stops at a mocked Port. dispatcher-gate.patch.pending parks only the first pattern read and never runs through PatternsTab or the Port host. A regression in signal forwarding, host disconnect, or approval cleanup can pass these cases.
findings.remedy: Add one connected regression with the actual PatternsTab, runSavedPattern, saved-operation Port host, and runLocalSavedPattern; park the underlying pattern read, cancel from the row, release it, then assert no approval, debugger action, rows, or health write. Run baseline RED and repaired GREEN, with the forcing-function mutation checks required by the test doctrine.

findings.title: Cancel-before-Port and post-approval preparation remain uncovered
findings.evidence: runSavedPattern dynamically imports document-network-transport before opening the Port (run-interactive.ts:544-545); the proposed UI test replaces runSavedPattern. After approval, executePreparedOperation calls prepare again (prepared-tool-operation.ts:74), and the proposed dispatcher test exercises only the first read. An abort during either gap has no proposed regression proof.
findings.remedy: Cover cancellation before the transport import resolves and while the second prepare is pending; verify no capture, late result, or health change. If import cannot be made interruptible, keep the row recoverable and state the limitation honestly.

findings.title: The controller changes behavior for non-Network runs
findings.evidence: candidate.patch.pending passes the new signal to every runSavedPattern call and aborts it on page change, unmount, or another Run. runSavedPattern sends AI runs to runAiExtractPattern, which never observes opts.signal (run-interactive.ts:118-233). The UI suppresses late output, but the agent stream can continue after an apparent cancellation or navigation.
findings.remedy: Scope this controller to Network runs, or make non-Network cancellation real and cover it separately. Do not describe an AI run as cancelled if only its UI result is hidden.

findings.title: Candidate documentation overstates the test seam
findings.evidence: CANDIDATE.md says the UI regression keeps the actual PatternsTab and Port transport, but the UI test mocks runSavedPattern; the Port test uses a fake runtime Port. No pending test has been executed, and the candidate itself says so.
findings.remedy: Correct the claim and keep all pending tests explicitly unverified until executed.

safetyChecks.cancelBeforeFirstPrepareResolves: Source check appears safe for debugger capture: runLocalSavedPattern awaits prepare then runPrepared enters executePreparedOperation, whose first action checks the aborted signal. Late preparation may still complete read/hash/scripting work.
safetyChecks.cancelWhileApprovalPending: The existing requestConfirmation abort listener expires the card and resolves denial; executePreparedOperation checks abort before re-preparation. A cancellation during persistence removes the pending record before broadcasting a card. Needs connected test proof.
safetyChecks.lateSuccessAndHealth: The proposed UI checks controller.signal.aborted before setRows or bumpPatternRun; the Port rejects on abort and the host aborts on disconnect. The pending test does not assert bumpPatternRun remains untouched after a late success.
safetyChecks.legitimateOrgAndUserHolds: No new preparation deadline is introduced. The active-organization resolver can legitimately hold while the picker is open. Progress text plus Cancel is preferable to a fixed timer, but no source-only review proves the picker and status are visible together.
safetyChecks.nonNetworkCallers: Agent tool calls do not use the proposed local-only progress labels; PatternsTab's new controller does affect DOM and AI saved runs as noted above.

limits: Source read only. No tests, build, browser, DB, installed-extension run, or mutation checks were performed. The candidate is pending and was not applied.
